collections.name: users
collections.description: User profile data and settings. A library lives entirely in this document's subcollections, so ownership is the path itself and no record carries a userId field.

collections.name: books
collections.description: Library books belonging to a user.

collections.name: shelves
collections.description: Library shelves belonging to a user.

collections.name: sharedLists
collections.description: Collaborative lists. Top-level by design: a list is read and edited by several users, so it cannot live under one owner's document.

securityRules.read: resource.data.isPublic == true || request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId || request.auth.uid in resource.data.memberIds
securityRules.update: owner: unrestricted; member: books only; invited or public: may add only themselves
